name: Moges Kidane Biru
role: PhD Candidate, Soil, Water, and Ecosystem Sciences
headline: I map soil health so land can be managed for what it is.
intro: Soil scientist and geospatial modeler at the University of Florida. I build context-aware soil health benchmarks and soil organic carbon maps, from Ethiopia to Brazil to Florida.
department: Department of Soil, Water, and Ecosystem Sciences
collab: Open to collaboration on soil health, geonutrition, geospatial analysis (GIS, remote sensing), and decision-support system development.
